column1: # The route to v0.5.2 (the owner, 13 Nov 2026). Kept by the orchestrator; the heartbeat's default view reads it.
# Tab-separated: id, title, lane, start (YYYY-MM-DD), end (YYYY-MM-DD), critical (y/n), after (ids, comma, or -), progress
# (lane:step in progress.tsv whose status gives this step's state; "-" for the orchestrator's own or the owner's).

column2: v0.5.1 cut: as R1 tested it, the upgrade rehearsal and the CHANGELOG
The poc manifest and its render test
OpenSearch on poc: render, Terraform, sign-in, what the client provides
Superset and report sync on Entra
The index feed: every change reaches the index, rebuild, drift check
The search service: names, full text, ranking, groups, suggestions, access
The Glass's screen fixes and the navigation (Part B)
The search results layout (Part A), against 3d's agreed shape
Client-size synthetic data at full scale, after the write-path fix (ADR-124 Am 18), loaded once
Promote an expansion to a batch job at the cap (ADR-151, the owner's ruling)
The batch job's screen: its choice on the cap refusal, progress and result (ADR-151)
The administrator fallback on Entra (audit 4c, ADR-148 Am 15), its post-merge live run
A merged pair arrives as one cluster: cluster ids when nodes enter the working set (rule 6; found live 14 Nov)
An upgrade or fresh install builds the search index (ADR-150 d4: no index made before v052-index has a fingerprint)
The measurement session on that load
Feature freeze (the moment the last open feature merges) and the wording sweep at once
edges_among in chunks (ADR-124 Am 20): a batch or view past ~10k nodes answers
Main's CI green (four fixes)
The top bar stays one line: less-used views fold into More views (the owner's design rule; fallback by Sun midday: all but Graph and Map at narrow widths)
The ontology read retried, so the Query builder and link types appear after a failed first read; step 6's live list (5 of 5)
The batch job's panel only on the canvas, not over Studio, Reports, Boards; a local-lite batch job proven to done
Type-ahead: case-sensitive suggestions fill their page; the limited line says its reason, never 'just now' when no index is configured
Refusals say 'People and roles', not 'Admin › People'; no raw field names in the Entra refusal
A watch stays active until three unreachable evaluations in a row (ADR-044; the owner's ruling, 14 Nov)
The Glass shows the Conduit's words for an access value not set, a token-version mismatch and a refused guest
Mark for suppression says what it does today: a mark and a reason, hiding nothing yet (the owner, 14 Nov)
The render's and spec 05's 'falls back to PostgreSQL' say what search really does when OpenSearch does not answer
The search results page says counts are per group, so All need not equal their sum (the owner, 14 Nov)
The map's attribution chip readable: a token background, measured in every look
The Glass shows the code's own version, not an older checkout's .git commit (the demo showed v0.5.0)
The Ingest Studio's messages say Pipeline, as its screens do, not recipe
Help (?) opens its panel from every view, not only Graph
The model's refusals in words: the provider's 429 and 401, a time-out said instead of a 500, a deadline on the Glass's model fetches (studio's demo research)
Only an administrator can give the osprey-admin role; a people manager is refused in words (studio's demo research; rule 4)
Mark for suppression survives a reload: the marks are read back, and a marked node offers Remove
Mark for suppression asks the analyst for a reason (ADR-046 step 1), not a fixed one
ospreyflow start --build rebuilds the search index, as install and update do
The fallback name search under its 5 s budget at client size: search_nodes from record ids found by index, not a scan of the store (ADR-124 Am 21)
The candidate: main after the sweep, with CI green on it
osprey-small (the GOV.UK demo) from the candidate, for client sign-ins (the owner, 14 Nov): backup, the gate, four sign-ins, health, a browser pass; restored if any check fails
The install test on the candidate, from the manifest: v0.5.1 upgraded, and a fresh v0.5.2 install, each with spec 08's poc scenarios
Cut v0.5.2; print the page tables; the demos when the owner says
